tips.text: Run Earth Capture or Exterminate on the Grineer Forest tileset, break every Kubrow Den, extract, and repeat for eggs.
Expect a wrong breed to cost another egg, another Power Core and 48 hours; each roll is about 1 in 5 with no pity.
Bring a fast frame like Volt, Loki or Nova and run the den sweep solo.
Pick up spare eggs by running Earth Exterminate fissures or Kuva Lich missions that land on the forest tiles.
Switch to two Chesa imprints after a miss or two; they make Chesa far likelier, not certain, and still cost an egg and a core.
Skip the Helminth cyst Drain option; it guarantees a Helminth Charger, never a Chesa.
Do Howl of the Kubrow first; Kubrow Dens drop eggs every time during its egg step.
Mature the pup in the Incubator before taking it on missions.
Scan one Kubrow Den with a Codex Scanner until it is fully scanned; dens then show through walls.
Cast a max-range Vast Untime with Xaku in each room to destroy dens you cannot see.
Shoot a den with a weak secondary first so more Kubrows come out before it breaks.
Do not reroll for fur, size or eye color; they change no stats.
Egg farming is the part people complain about; some report 30 or more runs with no egg, which is bad luck rather than a bugged node.
Chesa is rated a decent loot and disarm pet and a straightforward Mastery pickup.
